question: What is the significance of the constant washing of the mouth in this practice?
premises: Washing of the mouth is to be done always.
It is described as having gone upward.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is directed upward toward Brahman.
uncertainties: The ritual or symbolic meaning of ūrdhva-gata in this context is uncertain.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is directed upward to Brahman.
